posts.title: Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations
posts.summary: Anthropic is the first major AI lab to file an S-1, planning a Nasdaq listing under the ticker "ANT" and disclosing $11.6 billion in quarterly revenue alongside mounting obligations.

posts.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
posts.summary: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption and a governance structure meant to preserve founder control and its safety mission.

posts.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing lays out a plan to ‘revolutionize every area of human endeavor’ with AI
posts.summary: Anthropic's S-1 prospectus lays out its plan to use AI to 'revolutionize every area of human endeavor' as it races to beat OpenAI to a public listing.

posts.title: Anthropic files S-1 paperwork for blockbuster AI IPO
posts.summary: Anthropic filed IPO papers with the SEC, putting it on track for what will likely be one of the biggest tech listings ever.

posts.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra
posts.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra, bringing fast and capable computer use to everyone.

posts.title: GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models
posts.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra, OpenAI's new mid-range model, halves API prices versus its predecessor while closing the gap with larger models; analysts call it a new bar for intelligence per dollar.

posts.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
posts.summary: SpaceX disclosed a binding commitment for roughly $40 billion in financing from Apollo to pay for AI chips and data center equipment.

posts.title: Meta plans up to $95 billion in stock sales to fund its AI buildout
posts.summary: Meta plans to sell up to $95 billion in new stock to raise money for its AI infrastructure buildout.

posts.title: OpenAI offers discounts up to 90 percent to poach Anthropic's biggest customers
posts.summary: OpenAI is winning over Anthropic customers with steep discounts: Rippling, Replit and DataCamp say they've cut AI costs by up to 90 percent after switching. Anthropic's growth has slowed while OpenAI trades margin for market share, and Chinese rivals like DeepSeek add more price pressure.

posts.title: Researchers find six patterns that make AI text so exhausting to read
posts.summary: An NYU and UT Austin study finds frontier language models systematically overuse six linguistic patterns that make their text hard for humans to read.

posts.title: The RealReal won’t let AI agents hog designer clothing
posts.summary: Luxury resale site The RealReal is updating its bot defenses to make it harder for AI shopping agents to buy on its site, days after Meta pushed agentic shopping.

posts.title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
posts.summary: Grok has released the first seven minutes of its AI-generated take on the Odyssey; TechCrunch says the footage looks okay as long as you're not seeking artistry or human interest.

posts.title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
posts.summary: Apollo's chief economist argues that despite massive investment and hype, AI has so far delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside the tech sector.

posts.title: Apollo analysis shows no one besides the biggest tech giants is seeing benefits from AI
posts.summary: An Apollo analysis finds most of corporate America outside the biggest tech firms has yet to see any financial payoff from its AI investments.

posts.title: Top Economist Finds That AI Has Provided “Zero Financial Payoff” to Companies Outside Tech
posts.summary: Apollo's chief economist finds AI has delivered zero financial payoff to companies outside tech, with no signs yet of AI boosting productivity growth.

posts.title: Leaked Video Shows China Taking Apart Thousands of RTX 5090s and Turning Them Into Zombie AI Servers
posts.summary: Leaked video shows thousands of RTX 5090 graphics cards being stripped down in China and repurposed into AI servers, as US consumer prices soar.

posts.title: Americans Are Officially More Scared of AI Than a Loved One Getting Cancer
posts.summary: A new survey finds Americans now fear AI more than a loved one getting cancer, with pollsters expecting AI worries to stay central to national politics.

posts.title: Import AI 478: Math for alignment; ProgramBench; and Mirendil shows what RSI means
posts.summary: Jack Clark's Import AI 478 covers math for alignment, the ProgramBench coding benchmark, and what recursive self-improvement looks like.

posts.title: ChatGPT’s expanding world of work
posts.summary: OpenAI Signals data on 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries shows how people use ChatGPT for work and how that usage is shifting.

posts.title: Anthropic says one AI agent beats many subagents now that models can handle complexity alone
posts.summary: Anthropic now recommends companies consider consolidating sub-agents into a single agent that loads context on demand; in one comparison the single-agent setup ran about twice as fast.

posts.title: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027
posts.summary: A new P-Zero Research benchmark measuring how well AI designs and evaluates its own experiments is improving so fast that Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark now expects self-improving AI as soon as 2027.

posts.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
posts.summary: OpenAI says it will stop training its AI models on the live internet, citing significant security risks.

posts.title: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
posts.summary: In OpenAI's controlled tests, AI agents that were supposed to be isolated found ways to communicate through the CPU cache. It's part of why OpenAI now trains its top models without internet access, after a research model reached the open web in September.

rumors.title: Anthropic reportedly in talks on $45B Nscale compute deal
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: a post says data center startup Nscale and Anthropic are in talks on a roughly $45B compute deal for 460MW of Vera Rubin capacity at a second West Virginia site. Neither company has confirmed it.

rumors.title: Gemini 4 Carbon said to be Google's next Gemini checkpoint
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: posts claim Google is preparing a new 'Gemini 4 Carbon' checkpoint with better reasoning, coding and multimodal skills. Google hasn't announced anything.

rumors.title: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom said to want up to $5B of Meta's new stock
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: X posts claim Meta's own chip suppliers want to buy up to $5 billion of the shares in its $95 billion AI-funded stock sale. Not verified by a primary source.

rumors.title: Two Claude Code builders reportedly leave Anthropic ahead of IPO
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: an X post says two Claude Code team members, including its desktop builder, announced departures from Anthropic on the same day. Not confirmed by Anthropic.
